text: # Incident Report: FTTH Regional Outage — Fibre Cut **Document ID:** INC_C25_INC_2026_0179 **Category:** C25 — Broadband & FTTH Services **Department:** Network **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-08-06 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base --- ## Summary A construction excavation severed a primary fibre trunk affecting ~2,800 broadband customers. ## Detection Method Identified during routine NOC dashboard review, ahead of any customer-reported tickets. ## Timeline Outage detected 14:02 IST; splicing team dispatched; service restored 19:45 IST after trunk repair and re-splicing. | Time | Event | Observation | Action | |---|---|---|---| | T+0 | Fault detected | Alarm/ticket volume triggers investigation | On-call engineer paged | | T+10m | Initial triage | Affected scope estimated | Field/remote team engaged as needed | | T+Xh | Interim mitigation | Partial service restored where possible | Status page updated | | T+Yh | Full restoration | Service confirmed normal | Incident closed, RCA initiated if required | ## Customer Impact Estimated customers affected and service categories impacted are recorded in the internal incident-management system (ref: INC-2026-0179). Customer-facing status was published under Network > Service Status for the outage duration. ## Initial Hypothesis The initial working theory pointed to the most probable cause based on alarm signatures and affected-scope pattern; this was confirmed or revised during investigation. ## Investigation The response team correlated alarm data, affected-site/customer patterns, and any recent change or third-party activity in the area to isolate the fault to a specific component or cause before applying a fix. ## Resolution
title: FTTH Regional Outage — Fibre Cut
